metaTitle: Agentic AI Lab: LLM agents and multi-agent systems at Shanghai Jiao Tong University
metaDesc: AAIL, led by Chen Qian, studies LLM-based agents, multi-agent collaboration and collective intelligence; its work includes ChatDev, MacNet, Puppeteer and TeachMaster.
heroKicker: School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
heroTitle: A research lab for LLM agents that work together
heroLead: AAIL studies LLM-based agents, multi-agent collaboration and collective emergence, and turns the results into systems people use. ChatDev, MacNet and Puppeteer appeared at ACL, ICLR and NeurIPS.
heroPhotoAlt: Lab members in front of the ChatDev poster at ACL 2024
